notes: UK's online catalog pages could not be fetched and the department major page lists no course numbers, so the frame courses come from the 2022-23 UK transfer pathway guide (CS 115/215/216 pre-major; CS 315 and CS 498/499 in the major). The major requires CS 315 Algorithm Design and Analysis, so C3 is algorithms. No 2023+ public syllabus was found for any slot. C5/C6 added from web search only; the UK online catalog could not be opened. UK launches an AI major in Fall 2026, so a current catalog may list more AI courses.
